title: Opening, name, birthplace Mandeville and birth date
summary: Tape identification, full name Andrew Joe Anderson, born in Mandeville across the lake, 10 August 1905; Bunk played there with his father.

blocks.x: We're going if you want to put your name on here, you can start off so we don't have no identify the tape and you can just talk naturally, you don't pick up anything in the
room. Yeah, I want to ask any questions, don't I?

We want to get your name first. What is your name? Andrew Andy, Joe Anderson. Why is it Joe? Musician gave me the name. Do you have any other middle name though? Can you tell us just where you were born?
I was born in a little town called Manneville, Louisiana.
Across the lake, yeah. Bunk used to come over there on the weekends to play. You remember? Yeah, he played with my daddy, he used to play bass over there.
When were you born? What was your birthday?
I hate to tell everybody my birthday, but nevertheless since it's... This is part of history. It's history. None of your friends will hear this. I was born August 10th, 1905.
About the same age as me then, a little bit younger than me.
